transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Nisha. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hello Nisha, mera bill bahut zyada aaya hai is baar. I am very upset, please check karo kya hua hai.
Agent: I am sorry to hear that you are frustrated with your bill. I will definitely look into this for you.
Agent: Before we proceed, could you please provide your account number and date of birth for verification?
Customer: Haan, my account number is 68526005 and my date of birth is 07/02/1997. My name is Aisha Nair and my phone is 98293 22901.
Agent: Thank you, Ms. Nair. Let me check the charges. One moment please.
Customer: Please jaldi check karo, it is too much money for a simple plan.
Agent: I see here that you were charged twice for the international roaming pack. This was an error on our end.
Customer: Exactly! Maine toh sirf ek pack liya tha. Please fix this immediately.
Agent: I will raise a refund request for the wrong charge right now.
Agent: Please note that the refund is subject to approval and usually takes 7-10 business days to reflect in your account.
Customer: Theek hai, I understand. Thank you for finding the mistake.
Agent: You are welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Customer: Nahi, that is all. Thank you, Nisha.
Agent: Thank you for choosing Nimbus Telecom. I have raised the refund request, and you will receive an update soon. Goodbye!
